messages:
Aria Chen: Day 5 check-in — quick summary
Aria Chen: Did: finished laptop setup, enrolled in Okta, cloned the monorepo, ran unit tests for infra/*, and started following the runtime onboarding doc.
Aria Chen: Blockers: still getting 403 when `kubectl get pods` against dev cluster; GPU quota not visible in self-serve portal; internal PyPI package install failing with wheel mismatch.
Jules (buddy): Sorry you're stuck — DM me the `kubectl` output. For GPU quota, open a ticket with infra and mention `quota: gpu-dev`.
Aria Chen: Pasting `kubectl` error: "error: You must be logged in to the server (Unauthorized)" — I can get kubeconfig from IDP but maybe I'm missing group mapping.
it-ops-bot: Ticket created: #INFRA-2147 assigned to infra-oncall — Subject: kubeconfig group mapping for aria. ETA 4h.
Rory (engmgr): Thanks Aria — can you add a link to the PR you opened for the onboarding README tweaks? I'll do a quick review once infra confirms.
Aria Chen: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra-onboarding/pulls/8 — mostly doc fixes and a small script in scripts/setup_dev.sh
Jules (buddy): For the PyPI wheel issue try `pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel` then `pip install --index-url https://pypi.internal.redwood.ai yourpkg`. If it still fails, include the output here.
Aria Chen: Will try that now. Also got a ping from onboard-bot:
onboard-bot: Reminder — complete Security Basics course (due in 2 days) :link:
Aria Chen: Plan for today: follow up with infra ticket, try pip upgrade, unblock PR review, and pair with Jules on running the runtime smoke tests later this afternoon. Ping me if you want to pair :slightly_smiling_face:
Rory (engmgr): Sounds good. If infra doesn't respond by noon ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Jules (buddy): I'll be around after 3pm for smoke tests. Bring coffee. ☕
Aria Chen: Thanks everyone — will update here when infra tickets progress.
